definitions.gloss: Honshu; the main island of Japan
definitions.explanation: The largest and most populous of Japan's four main islands, home to major cities including Tokyo, Osaka, Kyoto, and Nagoya. Located between Hokkaido to the north and Shikoku and Kyushu to the south.

notes:
{本州|ほんしゅう} is the largest and most populous of Japan's four main islands, containing roughly 80% of the country's population.

WRITING:
{本|ほん} (main, true) + ⟦{州|しゅう}→州：03205_shuu⟧ (province, state). Literally "main province."

JAPAN'S FOUR MAIN ISLANDS:
- ⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧: Hokkaido (northernmost)
- {本州|ほんしゅう}: Honshu (largest, central)
- ⟦{四国|しこく}→四国：21447_shikoku⟧: Shikoku (smallest of the four)
- ⟦{九州|きゅうしゅう}→九州：15647_kyuushuu⟧: Kyushu (southernmost)

REGIONS ON HONSHU:
- ⟦{東北|とうほく}→東北：27542_touhoku⟧: Tohoku (northeast)
- ⟦{関東|かんとう}→関東：00186_kantou⟧: Kanto (includes Tokyo)
- ⟦{中部|ちゅうぶ}→中部：11367_chuubu⟧: Chubu (central)
- ⟦{近畿|きんき}→近畿：17061_kinki⟧/⟦{関西|かんさい}→関西：00179_kansai⟧: Kinki/Kansai (includes Osaka, Kyoto)
- ⟦{中国|ちゅうごく}→中国：28300_chuugoku⟧: Chugoku (western)

Honshu is the seventh-largest island in the world by area.
